Oh, also make sure that you have no skill point left before you change your job~
scripts.translation: 哦，还有，转职前别忘了把技能点全部用完~

scripts.text: I had to deal with the heat when I was in Morocc,
scripts.translation: 在梦罗克时得忍受酷热，到

scripts.text: and now I have to deal with the smog in this Einbroch!
scripts.translation: 了艾音布罗克，又得忍受烟雾！

scripts.text: But, I must admit that this is the perfect place for Blacksmiths because we have an abundance of crafting material supplies as well as highly developed equipment.
scripts.translation: 不过，我得承认，这里确实是铁匠的理想之地。材料供应充足，设备也很先进。

scripts.text: We, Blacksmiths are trying our best to forge the best of the best weapons.
scripts.translation: 我们铁匠一直竭尽全力，要锻造出最顶尖的武器。

scripts.text: We pledge our honor on that!
Good day, are you here to visit Blacksmith Guild?
scripts.translation: 你好，你是来参观铁匠公会的吗？

scripts.text: I thank you for coming this far to visit our guild. However, I regret to inform you that Blacksmith Guild has been
scripts.translation: 感谢您远道而来参观公会。不过，很遗憾，铁匠公会已经搬到修瓦鲁兹巴

scripts.text: moved to ^3131FF'Einbroch' in the Schwarzwald Republic^000000.
scripts.translation: 鲁德共和国的“艾音布罗克”了。 ^3131FF^000000

scripts.text: You can travel to Schwarzwald Republic by using the airship.
scripts.translation: 您可以乘坐飞空艇前往修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德共和国

scripts.text: I can provide you a teleport service to Izlude, where you can use the airship.
scripts.translation: 。我可以把您传送到依斯鲁得岛，那里就能搭乘飞空艇

scripts.text: Would you like to move to Izlude immediately?
scripts.translation: 。您要现在前往依斯鲁得岛吗？

scripts.text: Oops, haven't you used the airship yet?
scripts.translation: 哎呀，您还没坐过飞空艇吗？

scripts.text: Unlike Rune-Midgarts Kingdom, Schwarzwald Republic has 'the airship' instead of teleport services to move between towns.
scripts.translation: 和卢恩·米德加兹王国不同，修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德共和国的城镇间交通不是靠传送服务，而是靠飞空艇。

scripts.text: In ^3131FF'Izlude'^000000, you can use ^3131FF'the international airship'^000000 which travels between ^3131FFIzlude and Juno in Schwarzwald Republic^000000.
scripts.translation: 在依斯鲁得岛，您可以搭乘国际飞空艇，往返于依斯鲁得岛和修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德共和国的朱诺之间。 ^3131FF^000000^3131FF^000000^3131FF^000000

scripts.text: Take the airship, and go to Juno. Then from Juno, you need to take ^3131FFthe domestic airship^000000 to go to Einbroch.
scripts.translation: 先乘飞空艇到朱诺，再换乘国内飞空艇前往艾音布罗克。 ^3131FF^000000

scripts.text: Remember, you are ^3131FFnot going outside of the airport^000000 upon transit from the international to the domestic airship.
scripts.translation: 记住，从国际飞空艇换乘国内飞空艇时，不要走出机场。 ^3131FF^000000

scripts.text: It might sound complicated, but you will know once you are in the airport.
scripts.translation: 听起来可能有点复杂，不过到了机场，您就明

scripts.text: When you arrive in Blacksmith Guild, please send my regard to my coworkers!
scripts.translation: 白了。到铁匠公会后，请代我向同事们问好！

scripts.text: Excuse me, but you do not have enough money.
